title: GTA6 and Scrapped Liberty City DLC: Massive 200GB Leak Emerges
description: Eurogamer reports that a massive 200GB GTA 5 leak suggests Rockstar Games scrapped a Liberty City DLC and includes very early GTA 6 files. (Unconfirmed)
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Massive GTA 5 Leak Surfaces Online

According to a recent report by gaming outlet Eurogamer, a massive leak involving nearly 200GB of what is claimed to be GTA 5 source code has emerged. This unexpected data dump has once again drawn intense attention to developer Rockstar Games, offering an unprecedented, albeit unauthorized, look into the studio's behind-the-scenes development history and plans that never made it to the public.

Based on the details surrounding the leak, the massive collection of files suggests that Rockstar Games once started working on a substantial Liberty City expansion or DLC for GTA 5. However, for reasons currently unknown, the project was ultimately scrapped, leaving fans to only wonder what could have been regarding the return to the iconic location within the newer engine generation.

## Early GTA6 Development Files Included

In addition to the clues pointing toward the abandoned Liberty City DLC, the leaked 200GB data cache reportedly contains very early files related to GTA 6. Given the preliminary nature of these assets and source materials, they likely represent the earliest conceptual or foundational phases of the highly anticipated sequel's long development cycle.

While leaks of this scale generate massive excitement and endless speculation across the gaming community, it is essential to remember that these files are unverified and represent discarded or very raw ideas that do not reflect the final state of Rockstar Games' upcoming projects.

## Editor's Take

(This report is based on media coverage of an unconfirmed leak.) This massive 200GB data breach highlights the ongoing security challenges faced by major game developers. While it is fascinating to catch a glimpse of a scrapped Liberty City DLC and the earliest traces of GTA 6 work, players should approach these unverified rumors with caution and await official announcements from Rockstar Games.
